summary.intent: Run the GSD manager to discuss, plan, and execute three UAT gap-closure phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) for the CipherBox v1.1 milestone using the wave-based parallel execution system.
summary.outcome: Phase 42 (API unpin integrity) was fully completed — 8 plans executed across 3 waves, code reviewed, verified against live DB, and marked complete. Phases 43 and 44 were discussed with CONTEXT.md committed; planning/execution for 43 and 44 was pending at session end.

repo: The POST /ipfs/unpin endpoint was behind JwtAuthGuard only with no ownership check — any JWT holder (signup is open via Web3Auth) could unpin any CID, constituting a real cross-tenant data-destruction surface.

Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile in staging but still participates in the public DHT — port 4001 is exposed publicly (tcp+udp), so provider records for every pinned CID are broadcast to DHT crawlers. The 'server' profile only disables local-network discovery.
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning (shared-write.ts:450) — no legitimate cross-user unpin path exists in the current codebase.
BYO unpin was broken in both directions prior to Phase 42; server-side fix covers non-BYO; BYO client wiring deferred.

pnpm/jest flag passing is broken: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X` causes pnpm to insert a `--` separator that jest treats as a positional regex pattern. Correct form: `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern='X'`.
Running `nest build` as a side effect reformats openapi.json (564+ lines of formatting-only diff) even with no schema changes — requires `git checkout --` restore before worktree merges.
No .prettierignore existed in the repo, causing prettier to corrupt .planning/ markdown tables and VALIDATION.md test commands (pipe characters mangled into table columns).
The gsd commit helper (`query commit`) returns `"committed": false` as a false negative even when the commit actually landed — always verify with `git log` before retrying.
1Password SSH commit signing requires `dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true` in Bash tool calls; a signing failure usually means the 1Password app needs a restart rather than a retry.
The `cleanup-wave` helper resolves the repo root from its cwd — running it from inside an agent worktree produces false `base_mismatch` errors. Must always run from the repo root.
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report `branch_mismatch` on rerun, aborting the whole run. Reduced manifests with only remaining entries are required for reruns.

code.finding: Kubo v0.40 configured with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). Server profile suppresses only LAN discovery — full public DHT participation is retained, meaning every pinned CID's provider record is harvestable.

Upload-compensation path fires a global pin/rm on a CID without checking ownership — content-addressed dedup means this can destroy another user's pin. Fixed in Phase 42 by routing through guardedUnpin.

guardedUnpin added in Phase 42: pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(cid)) serializes concurrent deletes, transactional row-delete+refcount+pending_unpins outbox insert, cross-user audit metric emitted, silent 2XX for all outcomes.
IPNS conflict handling (Phase 44 target): needs three-way merge via baseChildren param, 4-attempt backoff+jitter loop, typed ConflictError, file CAS latest-wins with loser-becomes-version semantics.

workflow: Wave-based worktree execution isolates parallel plan agents — each gets a fresh git worktree off a captured base SHA; manifests track worktree paths for post-wave merge via cleanup-wave.
The gsd-code-reviewer is advisory-only and must never block phase progression; regardless of findings the pipeline always continues to verify_phase_goal.
Human-verify checkpoints in blocking plans (e.g., migration apply) can be auto-approved under --auto if automated verification (to_regclass query) independently confirms the expected state.
Per-phase feat/ branches are managed automatically by GSD; the orchestrator never commits directly to main.
Decision coverage gates use mechanical grep for literal D-XX: citations — plans must include explicit truth lines matching that pattern, not just contextual descriptions of the decision.
Node.js YAML extraction via inline node -e is more reliable than awk/sed for parsing frontmatter key_files sections across SUMMARY.md files with variable indentation.
Worktree cleanup requires removing node_modules and .husky/_ before merge to avoid untracked-file conflicts; later executor prompts should include explicit CLEANUP instructions.
RAM constraint: subagents must never run full monorepo test suites — always use targeted --testPathPattern filters.

friction: 1Password SSH signing failures required restarting the 1Password app mid-session; the error 'agent returned an error / fatal: failed to write commit object' gives no actionable hint without prior knowledge.
gsd commit helper false negatives caused blind retries and confusion — verifying every commit with git log added overhead throughout the session.
cleanup-wave cwd sensitivity (must run from repo root) caused false base_mismatch errors when accidentally invoked from a worktree directory.
cleanup-wave's non-idempotent abort behavior required writing reduced manifests for partial reruns instead of simply retrying.
zsh multi-glob rm abort: `rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules` fails entirely if any glob target is missing — requires individual rm calls.
Planner agent socket error mid-execution (after writing plans 01-03) required manual filesystem verification and spawning a continuation agent for plans 04-08.
42-05 worktree merge left MERGE_HEAD in an unresolved state after auto-conflict resolution — required manual `git commit --no-edit` and worktree cleanup.
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build required explicit `git checkout --` restore before every wave 3 merge.
Session context limit hit mid-code-review workflow requiring a full context summary and continuation handoff.
pnpm --filter test flag passing silently breaks jest pattern matching — error manifests as running wrong tests, not a clear flag error.
User had to intervene twice due to accidental keyboard input ('touring wyatt web bossy') during execution.
open_items: Phase 43 (FUSE write durability): CONTEXT.md complete, planning and execution not yet started. Three separate platform plans required (all platforms in scope).
Phase 44 (IPNS conflict handling): CONTEXT.md complete, planning and execution not yet started.
SECURITY.md missing for Phase 42 — `/gsd:secure-phase 42` flagged but not yet run.
Pending-uploads UI: full in-progress uploads indicator with count/progress deferred as a future improvement (noted in Phase 43 CONTEXT.md).
BYO provider.unpin client wiring: server-side guardedUnpin covers BYO advisory rows, but client-side `provider.unpin` is not wired into BYO delete flows — deferred from Phase 42.
Writable-share prunedCids leak: shared-write.ts drops prunedCids without unpinning — deferred from Phase 42 scope.
Rust FUSE merge parity: conflict-handling logic analogous to Phase 44 in the Rust FUSE layer was deferred.
Read-only drift report (detect-only pin ls diff vs pinned_cids): implemented as part of Phase 42 outbox worker but no alerting on the detected orphans beyond the metric.
